name: sol-pi-advisor
description: Sol plans and accepts, one or more safe local Pi lanes implement, and a fresh Sol reviewer gives the final verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Sol directs serial or parallel Pi implementation and fresh Sol review.
interface.longDescription: A supervised local delivery workflow: the primary Sol task owns architecture and acceptance, one Pi lane or a safe parallel wave implements in isolated Git worktrees, and a fresh read-only Sol agent reviews the integrated accepted diff.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Pi Advisor to implement this task through local Pi and fresh Sol review.
Plan a dependency DAG in Sol, delegate serial or safe parallel implementation to Pi, verify and integrate the diffs, then obtain fresh Sol review.
